about.calculations_hardware_reading_diag: Calculations, hardware reading and diagnostics in Rust. The native interface is drawn with GPUI, without a web engine or Chromium.
about.computy_interrogates_smartctl_json: Computy interrogates smartctl in JSON and interprets its return code as a bit mask. NVMe alerts, media errors, pending sectors and available history are examined. Standby discs may remain unsurveyed.
about.computy_makes_physical_diagnostics: Computy makes physical diagnoses accessible, without hiding their limits.
about.control_not_available_absent_inter: Control not available, absent or interrupted.
about.dedicated_file_created_without_cru: A dedicated file, created without crushing, is filled with different patterns by block, synchronized and then reread and compared byte by byte. It is then deleted. This control relates to the volume of Computy data and does not constitute a test of all sectors.
about.desktop_software_observe_hardware_: A desktop software to observe your hardware, check its behavior and keep track of its evolutions.
about.diagnostics_their_history_remain_m: Diagnostics and their history remain on your machine. You decide when to export a report or open an external resource.
about.engine_allocates_bounded_area_writ: The engine allocates a bounded area and writes several patterns: virtual addresses, zeros and ones, checker, pseudo-random sequences and moving bits. It then checks the words in both directions, with volatile accesses to prevent the deletion of the operations by the compiler.
about.no_anomalies_detected_check_perfor: No anomalies detected by the check performed.
about.physical_locking_attempted_result_: The physical locking is attempted and its result is recorded. The caches remain active; without locking, pages can be exchanged on the disk. The ECC Linux meters are read when they are accessible.
about.readable_note_never_guarantee: A readable note, never a guarantee
about.report_notes_lowest_score_exploita: The balance sheet notes the lowest score of exploitable checks. Unavailable checks reduce coverage and remain visible. An interrupted diagnosis does not get an overall score of success.
about.test_run_os_cannot_check: A test run in the OS cannot check the memory occupied by the system. Even a standalone test may miss an intermittent failure, depending on the temperature or a combination of components. A correct result means "no errors observed under these conditions".
about.unavailability_data_remains_unknow: An unavailability of data remains unknown. An interrupted control remains incomplete. Each result retains its measurements and scope.
about.up_four_threads_calculate_sha: Up to four threads calculate SHA-256 of a million characters "a" and whole sums, compared to known fixed responses. Duration, number of calculations and divergences are recorded. This control does not cover all instructions or prolonged stability.
about.verified_error_physical_alert_pres: A verified error or physical alert is present.
about.wear_history_errors_requiring_exam: Usure or history of errors requiring examination.
about.what_controlled_what_cannot_certif: What is controlled, and what cannot be certified.
about.why_no_serious_software_promises: Why no serious software promises "100% reliable"

offline.before_changing_anything_keep_re: Before changing anything, keep your recovery key if your disk uses encryption, including BitLocker or TPM unlocking. Changing Secure Boot may require this key. On a managed PC, contact your administrator.
offline.boot_storage_does_not_guarantee: The boot storage does not guarantee automatic return. Computy refuses Btrfs, RAID, LVM or encrypted configurations for this route.
offline.built_test_component_missing_rei: The built-in test component is missing. Reinstall the Computy package; no separate download of Memtest86+ is required.

offline.computy_cannot_determine_state_s: Computy cannot determine the state of Secure Boot. Automatic preparation is blocked to avoid incompatible booting.

offline.opening_computy_new_result_event: At the opening of Computy, a new result event is recovered and added to history.

offline.route_requires_real_pc_disabled: This route requires the real PC. It is disabled in a container.

processes.all_accessible_processes_witho: All accessible processes, without a limit. Search by name or PID to find a process.
processes.cpu_share_total_processor_capa: CPU: share of total processor capacity. RAM: resident memory and share of physical RAM; shared pages may be counted more than once. Protected processes may hide their measurements.
processes.disk_per_process_rates_cover: Disk: per-process rates cover all volumes; percentages show each process’s share of observable I/O, not disk capacity usage. GPU: NVIDIA compute-process memory appears when supplied by the driver; this list does not cover all graphics processes or measure their GPU load.
settings.25_languages_local_dates_number: 25 languages · local dates and numbers · right-to-left support
settings.battery_sources_note: Read from the system (UPower and BlueZ on Linux, Bluetooth properties on Windows, the Bluetooth profile on macOS) without contacting the device. Some devices only report a level (Low, Normal, Full): Computy shows it as is instead of inventing a percentage.
settings.battery_style_shared: These indicators use the system tray style chosen above.
settings.closing_window_keeps_indicators: Closing the window keeps the indicators running in the background. Each indicator’s menu can reopen Computy, open preferences or quit the app completely.
settings.customize_appearance_settings_n: Customize the appearance and settings of your next diagnostics.
settings.enabled_default_ram_cpu_gpu: Enabled by default: RAM, CPU and GPU. Changes take effect after saving preferences.
settings.engine_keeps_memory_disk_space: The engine keeps a memory and disk space reserve. If the allocation is too high for the available resources, the control is refused rather than saturating your PC.
settings.gpu_readings_depend_driver_amd: GPU readings depend on your driver: AMD/NVIDIA on Linux, Windows performance counters and some IOAccelerator drivers on macOS. Unsupported GPUs remain unavailable.
settings.history_preferences_pending_imp: History, preferences and pending imports will be deleted. Personal exports are kept.
settings.keep_running_on_close: Keep running in the background when closed
settings.keep_running_on_close_hint: Closing the window keeps Computy and its indicators running. To quit, use the indicator menu.
settings.linux_desktops_need_appindicato: Linux desktops need AppIndicator/StatusNotifier support. GNOME may require a supporting extension. Windows may place indicators in its hidden-icons menu.
settings.no_wireless_devices: No connected wireless device reports its battery. Turn on or reconnect the device and it will appear here.
settings.one_indicator_per_device: One indicator per selected device. A disconnected device is hidden and comes back when it reconnects.
settings.one_indicator_per_selected_volu: One indicator per selected volume: the ring shows used space; its menu also shows read and write rates. These are usage measurements, not health scores.
settings.portable_version_delete_applica: Portable version: delete the application file or folder.
settings.refresh_intervals: CPU and RAM update every 2 seconds. GPU updates take up to 6 seconds depending on the driver. “—” means unavailable, rather than 0%.
settings.same_space_according_preference: The same space, according to your preference.
settings.show_wireless_batteries_hint: Mouse, keyboard, headset… Disabled by default. Changes take effect after saving preferences.
settings.starts_monitoring_background_wi: Starts monitoring in the background without opening the main window.
settings.system_ask_permission_data_kept: The system will ask for your permission. Data is kept.
settings.these_values_proposed_new_diagn: These values will be proposed in a new diagnosis.
settings.translations_included_app_no_tr: Translations are included in the app. No translation service is contacted.
